dedupe_keys.name: integrating climate change into culvert analysis

description: Integrating Climate Change into Culvert Analysis is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Thapa, Pawan (deposited on HydroShare). This module will provide the student with learning activities and tools needed to develop a basic knowledge of climate models, rainfall analysis,estimate runoff and culvert analysis. Coverage: not restricted to one place in the metadata. The resource was created 2025-09-28 and last updated 2025-11-12; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
